# Vendored third-party code

**three.js** — `three.module.js` + `three.core.js`
- Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- License: MIT (Copyright 2010-2026 Three.js Authors — see the `@license` header in each file)

Vendored (checked in verbatim) so the viewer runs with no build step and no package manager.
To update, replace both files with the matching pair from a three.js release and keep the headers intact.
